core_meaning.primary_meaning: Mikail corresponds to the Arabic form ميكائيل and is glossed in this record as “Like Allah.” The lexical gloss describes the word-form; Qur’anic occurrence, religious recommendation, popularity, and a name-bearer’s character are separate claims and are not established by this gloss alone.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Mikail corresponds to the Arabic form ميكائيل (Arabic مِيكَائِيل (Mīkāʾīl)). Its core sense is michael; an archangel's name. Mikail is Arabic مِيكَائِيل (Mīkāʾīl), the name of the archangel Michael, mentioned in the Qur'an. The source gloss 'Like Allah' is a loose rendering of the traditional Hebrew etymology; the documented identification is the archangel. Same name as mikaeel.

persian.name: میکائیل
